verdict: The finite calendar and the historical 8,460/6,222 rows share context, position, batch and KV format: 8K window, decode position 8191, batch 1, unscaled per-element FP8 E4M3 KV. They differ in how KV is delivered. The historical rows assume the KV is already on core, or streamed at PHY rate and fully overlapped. The calendar sends it through a 7x64 B on-die fill network at 1.2 GHz and serialises each layer's fill. The bytes are not double-charged and there are no cross-layer or cross-die re-reads; 150.69 MB/die/token is the minimum for this identity. The headline published in the atlas and HEADLINE_BUNDLE is a different identity: the TP2 two-reticle package with DFlash.

q2_bytes_and_gap.logical_formula: 36 layers x 2 (K,V) x 2 KV heads/die x 128 dims x 8191 prior positions x 1 B
q2_bytes_and_gap.the_150847488_figure: = 4,713,984 commands x 32 B = RD 4,709,088 + WR 4,896 (model-r4.json:137,140; 32,736 cmds/stack/layer). It is read plus write commands, not '2 heads x 8,184 positions'. CURRENT_WORK_HANDOFF_2026_10_03.md:118 mislabels it as KV read bytes
q2_bytes_and_gap.conclusion_minimal: 150,690,816 B/die/token is minimal for HBM-resident FP8 KV at position 8191. It is already about 0.2% under the logical total because of the tail bypass.
q2_bytes_and_gap.historical_basis: 150.69 MB / (4 x 0.9 TB/s) and treated as hidden under compute (MICROARCH_MODEL.md:1003 'binding compute chain')
q2_bytes_and_gap.calendar_fill_floor_basis: busiest lane 9,380 beats/layer x 36 / 1.2 GHz (model-r4.json:77-86); 7 lanes x 64 B = 448 B/edge = 537.6 GB/s vs PHY 3.6 TB/s
q2_bytes_and_gap.why_7_lanes: dimensioned to the 3,000 tok/s target (model-r4.json:66 target_s=1/3000; dimensioning.minimum_fill_integer=7), not to the PHY
q2_bytes_and_gap.serialisation_cost: small. The next layer's fill starts at the previous all-grants and attention (2.56 us/layer) overlaps it. The bound is fill width x efficiency, not the lease.

q3_kv_format.golden: FP8 E4M3 per element, unscaled, RNE, saturating at 448; default when HDC_SU_WIDTH>1 (tools/hdc_golden.py:261-280, landed 8a91421a3 2026-09-27)

q3_kv_format.adopted: FP8 E4M3 per element, unscaled (arch_budget_qwen3.py:62 KV_FMT_SPEC; qwen3_budget.json:18; atlas :638 'FP8 KV in attached HBM')
